policy: Only declared historical machine-root byte strings are replaced. Exact proof sources, pinned configuration, theorem types, axioms, exit-status content, and all remaining bytes are preserved. Original reports/returns remain unchanged at the archive-relative locations below; they are not included as unsanitised public copies.
mapping_convention: The original root is identified by its SHA256 and role rather than printed as a private machine path. Recover it from the unchanged preserved original, verify the prefix digest, and substitute the declared placeholder. Longest prefixes are applied first.

redactions.note: ZIP member replacements; per-member records identify the exact counts
